'''Foodboards''',<ref name="DB-Dex's Diner">{{DB|location|dexsdiner|Dex's Diner}}</ref> also spelled "'''food-boards'''," was a type of [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuff]] that could be sliced<ref name="Triple Zero" /> and perforated. [[Medium-density food-board]] was a type of foodboard that was used by the [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] to make [[slider]]s at his [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]], [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />

Around [[30 BBY/Legends|30 BBY]],<ref name="">''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]'' places [[Kal Skirata]]'s arrival on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to eight [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]]. Since the [[The New Essential Chronology]] dates the battle to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Skirata arrival must have occurred around [[30 BBY/Legends|30 BBY]].</ref> the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Kal Skirata]] had foodboard in the kitchen area of his quarters on the planet [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. At one point, Skirata served sliced foodboard&mdash;which he thought looked less appetizing than the tray it was on&mdash;to the young [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando|Null ARC troopers]] that he was training on Kamino.<ref name="Triple Zero" />

==Behind the scenes==
Foodboards were first mentioned in the [[2002]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]'' written by [[David West Reynolds (real person)|David West Reynolds]].<ref name="AotC Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> They first appeared in ''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]'', the second novel in the [[Republic Commando]] series written by [[Karen Traviss]] and released in [[2006]].
